summary.summary: Deshay Ramos, the real estate agent for a property in Casa Grande, called Arizona Roofers to request a roof inspection and an inspection report for 159 East Pebble Trow, ZIP 85122, as the owner (Ted) has not been at the home for a while and they want to address any potential age-related repairs before listing the property. The representative explained that inspection reports differ from standard repair estimates and confirmed there were no known current roof issues. Deshay confirmed the home is in an HOA, has no solar panels, and that no special access (such as gate codes) is needed. Deshay was set as the main point of contact, will review the proposal with Ted, provided an email for the proposal, and approved SMS confirmations. The appointment was scheduled for Monday, January 19, 2026, in the 1–3 PM window, with the requirement that someone be present for liability; Deshay agreed and will call back if anything changes, and the rep advised a confirmation text and a 30-minute-out notification from the technician.
key_points: Caller is Deshay Ramos, the agent for the property; the owner is Ted, and Deshay will be the main point of contact and will go over the proposal with Ted.
Service requested: roof inspection and an inspection report for 159 East Pebble Trow, Casa Grande, AZ 85122; no known current roof issues, but concerns due to roof age (age unknown).
Property details captured: in an HOA; no solar panels; no special access/gate code needed; appointment scheduled for 2026-01-19 from 1:00 PM to 3:00 PM and someone must be present.
action_items: Perform the scheduled roof inspection at the property during the 1–3 PM window on 2026-01-19.
Send the proposal/inspection information to Deshay at deshay.holmesaz@gmail.com after the inspection.
next_steps: Customer receives SMS confirmation and technician provides a 30-minute-out call/text on the day of the appointment.
After inspection, Deshay reviews the proposal with Ted and, if proceeding, provides Ted’s information.
